name: Floret
author: E. T. Carter
description: A sunflower spiral of crisp dots — seeds placed on the golden angle so they pack into the interlocking Fermat spirals of phyllotaxis, colour grading outward by radius while a brightness pulse travels through the rings as the whole head turns.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the spiral head; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Size
params.effect: Seed spacing and overall size of the head; low packs it tight and small, high spreads it past the frame.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Dot radius relative to spacing; low is airy points, high nearly touches into a solid head.

params.label: Pulse
params.effect: Strength of the brightness wave travelling outward through the rings; 0 is steady.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer nudges the spiral centre; 0 ignores the mouse.
